repairs.before: Hover replaces the inner event component; first click and keyboard focus regressions both failed.
repairs.after: A stable context consumer calls the current render callback without changing component identity.

repairs.component: Event bus across independently loaded module copies
repairs.before: Real Redis delivered three distinct publications to one subscriber and none to the other because module-local consumers competed in one group.
repairs.after: A process-wide registry shares the consumer and handlers. Both subscribers receive the same three unique event IDs. Monitoring works through both module copies; closing, reopening in the original module, and closing a stale handle preserve the replacement connection.

limits: The normal Microsoft calendar browser journey still requires a newly built candidate containing these repairs. The diagnostic hover workaround is absent from the checked-in journey.
The process-wide registry addresses independently bundled copies within one process; heterogeneous subscribers in separate processes require a separate fanout design.
F034 remains incomplete; Microsoft mail and Teams journeys remain outstanding.
